descriptions.zh-Hans: 整理茶柜的人留下一张包过干茶的净纸，托邮局装进礼盒。展开时，一角还带着淡淡的香。
descriptions.en: Someone tidying a tea cupboard saved this clean sheet from a packet of dry tea for the gift box. One corner still carries a little scent.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 一位收过礼盒的人把缎带寄了回来，请柜台替下一份礼物打个结。两端长短不齐，中间的圈倒很圆。
descriptions.en: A past gift-box recipient sent this ribbon back for the next present. Its ends are uneven, but the loop in the middle is wonderfully round.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 装信的人剪下两只用剩的信封角，叠成一个小纸袋。袋口还留着半个没写完的字，里面刚好放下一句晚安。
descriptions.en: Someone packing letters joined two spare envelope corners into a little pocket. Half a handwritten word remains at the opening, with room inside for a good night.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 帮忙补邮包的人把余下的彩线缝在硬纸上，五条短线凑成一颗星。最后一针绕得有点远，像给星星留了条尾巴。
descriptions.en: After mending a mailbag, a helper stitched the leftover threads onto card. Five short lines make a star; the last stitch wanders off like a little tail.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 等柜台空下来时，有人在废纸上画了一排大小不一的脚印，临走留给了邮局。最小的那一双悄悄朝旁边转了弯。
descriptions.en: While waiting at the counter, someone drew footprints of every size on scrap paper and left it behind. The smallest pair quietly turns out of the queue.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 整理印台时，一个沾了印泥的指头在余纸上按出了圆印。旁边的人添上几道光，再一起把它放进礼盒。
descriptions.en: A thumb smudged with stamp ink left a round print on spare paper. Someone nearby added rays, and together they tucked the little sun into a gift box.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 修窗的人在余木片上画了三种窗格，让大家挑喜欢的一种。没人舍得把另外两种擦掉，于是三扇小窗一起留下了。
descriptions.en: A window repairer drew three possible grids on a wood offcut. Nobody wanted to erase the two that were not chosen, so all three little windows stayed.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 补衣服的人送来一枚配不成对的木扣，背面用铅笔画着弯月。两只扣眼在月亮旁边，看起来像还没睡的小眼睛。
descriptions.en: A mender donated a wooden button without a match and drew a crescent on its back. Beside the moon, the two buttonholes look like eyes still awake.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 空线轴被磨平了毛边，盖上一小片软布，变成谁也坐不下的小凳。做它的人说，可以请最累的那颗扣子歇一会儿。
descriptions.en: An empty spool, its rough edges smoothed and its top covered with soft cloth, became a stool too small for anyone. Its maker suggested seating the most tired button there.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 裁短袖子剩下的布，被来帮忙的裁缝缝成一面小帆。边上还留着原来的缝线，像一条陪它走过旧衣服的路。
descriptions.en: A tailor helping at the post office made this tiny sail from a shortened sleeve. The old seam remains along one edge, a little road from its life as clothing.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 擦桌子时，有人看见水盆里倒着一扇窗，便描在干净的包纸上。画完才发现窗是反的，就在背面写了“翻过来看”。
descriptions.en: Someone wiping a table traced the window reflected in a basin onto clean wrapping paper. Finding the drawing reversed, they wrote “look from the other side” on the back.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 长凳上原本替一只空盒占着位子，纸牌写着“很快回来”。盒子被拿去装礼物以后，这张牌也跟着住进了礼盒。
descriptions.en: This “back soon” card once saved a bench seat for an empty box. When the box was put to work holding a present, its seat card came along.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 柜台削铅笔时留下了一圈完整的木屑，写地址的人把它粘在卡片上。卷边不肯压平，倒像一朵刚刚张开的花。
descriptions.en: A whole curl survived a pencil sharpening at the counter. Someone addressing a letter glued it to a card; its stubborn raised edges look like a flower just opening.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 修柜台铃的人试了三次声音，旁边的孩子用高低不同的小点记下来。第三个点画得很大，说那一声最像有人到家。
descriptions.en: While a counter bell was being repaired, a child marked three test rings with dots at different heights. The largest dot was for the ring that sounded most like someone coming home.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 补衣服剩下的一小块布，被缝成了装不下手指的口袋。送来的人在里面放了一张写着“谢谢”的细纸，才让它进礼盒。
descriptions.en: A scrap left from mending became a pocket too small for a finger. Its maker slipped a narrow paper “thank you” inside before sending it to the gift box.

descriptions.zh-Hans: 装盒时剩下的长纸边，被两个人一来一回折成了小梯。拉开有好多级，收拢以后，最高一级又回到了最下面。
descriptions.en: Two helpers took turns folding a long strip left from wrapping into a little ladder. Stretched out it has many steps; folded shut, its highest step returns to the bottom.
